title: Lossless Complete-Through-Cutoff Inventory Evidence Grouping
selectedSlice: B â€” pure lossless grouping prerequisite
purpose: Transform one successfully exhausted FOOD-006J exact-SKU ledger set into one lossless immutable exact-batch grouping without FOOD-006C cardinality limits, durable reads or balance composition.
rules: Input is the successful value produced by FOOD-006J complete-through-cutoff enumeration.
Exact SKU and acquired cutoff are retained unchanged.
Every production-batch ledger entry establishes exactly one exact batch group.
Every physical-inventory-movement ledger entry must attach to an existing exact batch group.
A movement whose exact batch has no production-batch ledger entry fails closed.
Duplicate exact production-batch ledger identities fail closed.
Duplicate physical inventory movement identities fail closed globally.
Every input evidence sequence must be a positive safe integer, strictly increasing and less than or equal to cutoff.
Every ledger entry must bind the same exact SKU as the exhausted input.
Each exact batch group retains its production-batch evidence sequence.
Each movement retains its own evidence sequence.
No evidence is dropped, truncated, partitioned or duplicated.
FOOD-006K does not truncate evidence.
A batch may retain more than 128 movements.
The complete grouping may contain more than 128 exact batches.
Group ordering is deterministic by exact batch identity rather than ledger pagination boundaries.
Movement ordering within each batch is deterministic by evidence sequence.
The output is detached and deeply frozen.
FOOD-006K does not construct a FOOD-006C manifest.
FOOD-006K performs no persistence or durable reads.
FOOD-006K does not call FOOD-006D, FOOD-006E, FOOD-006F or FOOD-006G.
FOOD-006K does not compose recorded physical balance.
FOOD-006K does not establish authoritative current quantity-on-hand.
FOOD-006K grants no capacity, availability, checkout, payment, fulfillment, accounting or rewards authority.
Migration 0005 remains definition-only and unexecuted.
whyNot006CPartitioning: A single exact batch may legitimately have more than 128 movement ledger entries through one FOOD-006J cutoff.
Partitioning that batch into multiple manifests would create multiple independent representations of the same production batch.
Later independent 005Z composition of those partitions could reapply producedPackageCount more than once.
The lossless grouping therefore preserves one exact batch group containing all of that batch's movement evidence.
deferred: FOOD-006L durable exact resolution of each grouped batch and movement through FOOD-006D.
